BR-38

BRAKE SYSTEM — Rear Brake

INSTALLATION OF CYLINDER
(See page BR-31)

1. INSTALL PADS
(See step 7 to 8 on page BR-32 and 33)

2. INSTALL CYLINDER
(See step 9 on page BR-33)

3. INSTALL FLEXIBLE HOSE TO BRAKE CYLINDER
Torque: 235 kg·cm (17 ft·lb, 23 N·m)

4. FILL BRAKE RESERVOIR WITH BRAKE FLUID AND BLEED BRAKE SYSTEM
(See page BR-6)

5. CHECK FOR LEAKS
